T: The mask passes on. So does the recipe.
D: An ageing Zorro trains a young thief to take his place and avenge his family in old California.
P: Serve the mains when Alejandro and Elena dance at Don Rafael's party.
S: Red wine chorizo, Manchego with quince paste, warm olives with orange peel
Chorizo slices fried and finished in red wine until sticky, Manchego cut into triangles with quince paste, and olives warmed with orange peel.
light masa and spicy shredded chicken in corn husks, steamed firm, before the secret gold mine

Masa beaten light with lard and stock, spread on soaked corn husks, filled with chicken in red chilli sauce, folded and steamed until firm. Soak 16 dried corn husks in hot water for 30 minutes. Poach 500g chicken thighs, shred and mix with 250ml red enchilada sauce. Beat 150g lard until fluffy, then beat in 450g masa harina, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp salt and 450ml warm chicken stock. Spread 3 tbsp masa on each husk, add a spoon of chicken, fold and stand upright in a steamer. Steam covered for 75 minutes and serve with salsa.
Monterey Jack and roasted green chilli quesadillas with a Z scored on top
Flour tortillas filled with Monterey Jack and roasted green chilli, cooked in butter until golden and melted, a Z scored into the top before cutting into wedges.
M: Lime and orange marinated skirt steak, sliced thin, with rice and black beans

Skirt steak marinated 2 hours in lime, orange, garlic and cumin, grilled over very high heat, rested, sliced against the grain, with rice, black beans and fresh salsa. Marinate 800g skirt steak for 2 hours in lime and orange juice with crushed garlic and cumin. Grill over very high heat for 3 minutes a side, rest and slice thinly against the grain. Serve with long grain rice, warm black beans and a fresh tomato salsa.
Governor's chicken with olives and capers

Chicken thighs browned crisp, then braised with garlic, white wine, tomato, green olives and capers until tender, served with crusty bread to mop the sauce. Season 8 bone-in chicken thighs and brown skin side down in olive oil for 8 minutes. Remove, soften 4 sliced garlic cloves and a sliced onion, then add 200ml white wine and a 400g can of tomatoes. Stir in 100g green olives and 2 tbsp capers, return the chicken skin side up and braise uncovered at 170C for 40 minutes. Scatter with parsley and serve with crusty bread.
W: Cinnamon sugar churros with thick hot chocolate for dipping
Choux dough piped into 180C oil, fried golden, rolled in cinnamon sugar, with thick hot chocolate.
K: Red wine, brandy, orange and apple chilled in a jug and topped with soda

Red wine, a splash of brandy, orange juice and sliced orange and apple in a big jug, chilled 2 hours, topped with soda water just before pouring. Slice 2 oranges and an apple into a big jug. Pour in a bottle of red wine, 60ml brandy and 250ml orange juice. Chill for 2 hours so the fruit soaks it up. Top with cold soda water just before pouring into glasses over ice.
